snippet.title: Clockwork Ambrosia - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Clockwork Ambrosia is available on Steam on 12 May 2026 for Windows and Steam Deck! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/896010/Ambrosia/ 

Play as Iris in this Metroid/Mega Man-inspired action platformer. Scour the island of Aspida for game-changing weapon mods to craft your own unique arsenal in a quest to solve the island's mysteries and escape the grasp of its mysterious overlords.

Break the rules. Build like Clockwork.

Trailer Credits
Music composed by @willaleshiremusic 
Editing by Jonathan Lopez
Recording by Aeryn Clayton
Additional art by Annie Bradshaw
